```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
csv_name <- "chartbook_F18.csv"
csv_tmp  <- file.path(tempdir(), csv_name)
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GPID-WB/pip-chartbook/refs/heads/main/csv/chartbook_F18.csv",
  destfile = csv_tmp,
  mode = "wb",
  quiet = TRUE
)
# Plain <a download> holding the CSV as a data: URI.
# downloadthis::download_file() is deliberately NOT used here: the handler it
# generates calls fetch() on the data: URI, and PositConnect serves a
# Content-Security-Policy whose connect-src has no data:, so the fetch was
# blocked and the button failed with "Download failed. Please try again."
# An anchor download is not governed by any CSP directive.
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="cell-output-display"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="data:text/csv;base64,%s" download="%s"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download data as csv</a></div>',
  xfun::base64_encode(csv_tmp), csv_name
))
```

<p style="font-size: 0.5em; color: #555; margin-top: 0.5em;">

Note: Growth rates are calculated using PIP's [1000 Binned Global Distribution dataset.](https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0064304/1000-Binned-Global-Distribution)

</p>
